name: manual_eb4a1c
claim: LINT-006-style path-hygiene hooks flag literal absolute-path patterns even inside policy docs that WARN against them -- describe the pattern abstractly (e.g. 'an OS-specific absolute home-directory path') rather than spelling out the literal trigger string, in ALL docs explaining what not to do. Do NOT use a username placeholder notation either -- it still exposes directory structure; prefer reverse git repo-relative paths or path-free wording.

decisions.notes: Removes a live contradiction: this lesson recommended a username-placeholder notation that other, corrected path-hygiene lessons explicitly warn against.

rationale: Removes a live contradiction: this lesson recommended a username-placeholder notation that other, corrected path-hygiene lessons explicitly warn against.
